title: O Perfect Love
description: O Perfect Love in Tonic Solfa to PERFECT LOVE: the solfa with the words, staff notation, the three verses, and a piano.
about: Dorothy F. Gurney wrote the words in 1883. The tune PERFECT LOVE is by Joseph Barnby (1889).
underlay: O per-fect Love, all hu-man thought tran-scend-ing, Low-ly we kneel in prayer be-fore Thy throne, That theirs may be the love which knows no end-ing, Whom Thou for ev-er-more dost join in one.

lines: O perfect Love, all human thought transcending,
Lowly we kneel in prayer before Thy throne,
That theirs may be the love which knows no ending,
Whom Thou for evermore dost join in one.
O perfect Life, be Thou their full assurance
Of tender charity and steadfast faith,
Of patient hope, and quiet brave endurance,
With childlike trust that fears nor pain nor death.
Grant them the joy which brightens earthly sorrow,
Grant them the peace which calms all earthly strife;
And to life’s day the glorious unknown morrow
That dawns upon eternal love and life.
